provenance.chassis: datasheet-table - guide Table 1: 1.72 x 17.36 x 12 in (43.7 x 441 x 305 mm), 4.3 kg. Ears NOT MODELLED by convention
provenance.color: photo - medium grey face (#6d7175), aluminium rear
provenance.front: photo - recessed JUNIPER/junos panel to x 45.2, hex vent fields above the ports, the 2x4 RJ45 block at column centres 167.7-214.8 (15.7 mm measured pitch, upper jacks rotate 180 to keep both release tabs reachable), RJ45 8/9 at 232.6/250.3, SFP 10/11 at 280.3/294.5, SFP+ uplinks 0/1 at 323.3/337.5, mini-USB CON at 352.8, vertical USB at 365.0, MGMT at 381.4, and the SYS/ALM/MST/PH + SPD/DX/EN lamp matrix with the white beacon at the right end. LINK/ST lamp pairs sit above each SFP port; ports 8/9 carry their lamps inside the jack
provenance.leds: guide chassis-status table: SYS green steady = Junos loaded, blinking = booting; MST green steady = functioning; ALM red/amber = alarm (unlit = none); PH unused (off). Port and MGMT lamp tables exist in the guide; the per-port LINK/ST pairs are drawn with generic states
provenance.lifecycle: announced - the MX150 is EOL (image-library page redirects to the EOL notice; the intake's datasheet hunt recorded no standalone sheet). Per-SKU dates on the Juniper milestones page
provenance.other-faces: near-blank by evidence - rail bands estimated; axis conventions per viewer3d.js as on the siblings
provenance.port-numbering: photo - access ports print 0-11 (column pairs 01/23/45/67 under the RJ block, then 8, 9, 10, 11); the two SFP+ uplinks print 0 and 1 - a second numbering space (xe-0/1/x in the CLI), carried as printed
provenance.power: guide specifications: maximum power consumption 140 W. The vendor does not qualify an ambient - filed as max, and that reading is recorded here
provenance.rear: photo - earthing plate with two studs at the left (21.0/34.0, y 6.5, approximate), ESD socket below, two fixed fan rotors at x 65/122 (r ~17), the AC INPUT 100-240V 50-60Hz 3A MAX legend, power rocker at 390 and C14 inlet at 408. The supply is BUILT IN - no PSU bay exists on this platform
provenance.scale: photo - both photographs are straight-on but carry extra shadow/bezel rows, so x is anchored to the 441 mm width (front 3.245 px/mm, rear 3.184) and y positions are per-face fractions anchored to the 43.7 mm height - approximate to about a millimetre
provenance.sources: MX150 Hardware Guide (extracted into working/images/mx150/), the MX-family datasheet (no standalone MX150 datasheet exists - recorded in the intake), and the image-library photographs mx150-front-high and mx150-rear-high. No mechanical drawing was available
